Hi, Richard, it's Louisa. I have some news about the
Renewable Energy Trade Show. | just found out that the
Barnes Convention Center charges extra fees if events go

day. I know you've already placed the order for our sign
from the printers, but could you call and ask if we can make
a last-minute change to the design? It's not ideal, but we'll
avoid having to pay the extra charge for that hour. Thanks!

Barnes Convention Center
June
F 28~290
A.M.-8:00 P.M.
Admission: $25
